The '''Peaceful Dawn Rally''' was a protest that was held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaraksander]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Cyrstas Eloinie]], the daughter of [[Darred Eloinie|the CEO]] of the armaments firm [[Eloinie Petro-Munitions]], participated in the protest, but she was kidnapped during the event by the [[Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites]].
